label: Frontier oracle exploit, $15.6M, INV price manipulation
note: 2022-04-02: Frontier oracle exploit (~$15.6M); INV price manipulation via TWAP attack. Larger of the two 2022 issuer-damaging events.

label: Frontier oracle exploit, ~10.13M DOLA borrowed, ~5.83M DOLA net loss
note: 2022-06-16: Second Frontier oracle-manipulation exploit. BlockSec reports 10,133,949 DOLA borrowed (https://blocksec.com/blog/our-take-on-the-inverse-finance-security-incident-price-manipulation-attack). Inverse's July 13 proposal reports a net 5.83M DOLA loss (https://forum.inverse.finance/t/reopen-frontier/133). Cointelegraph reports ~$1.26M in attacker proceeds after the flash loan was repaid, a different quantity from protocol loss (https://cointelegraph.com/news/inverse-finance-exploited-again-for-1-2m-in-flashloan-oracle-attack). Sources read 2026-10-17.

label: Multichain collapse strands BSC/AVAX/FTM DOLA as unsupported IOUs
note: 2023-07-06: Following Multichain's unusual-activity announcement, bridge transfers paused and BSC, Avalanche and Fantom DOLA (anyDOLA) cannot bridge back (Multichain-DOLA Exploit FAQ, published 2023-07-15 (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Q5ew52Z8VwxcgkTapHNsBHoCtKqkyqYWRhwzjwRj40M/export?format=txt), Q4); holders advised to avoid Multichain-bridged DOLA while unresolved (Q11); no DAO compensation approved at publication (Q13). Sole enabled minters remain the Multichain routers/MPC; Inverse confirmed on 2026-10-28 that only canonical Ethereum DOLA is issuer supply and these representations are unsupported bridge IOUs with no Inverse backing or redemption guarantee.
